card.name: Words just before an age or time figure
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation right before a number or list item, such as "within" before hours, "aged" before 65, or a comma in a list of age groups. Also an opening quote mark before a quoted definition.

modes.label: Before hours or ages
modes.description: The word or space just before a number of hours or an age such as 65.
modes.example: A tropical storm watch means such conditions are possible<< within>> 48 hours.

modes.description: A comma after children in the list children, adolescents, and young adults.

modes.label: Opening of a quotation
modes.description: A quote mark or "to" starting a quoted formal statement from a charter or declaration.

card.writes: It suppresses the word "shall" and similar obligation words, so the text is less likely to continue with a rule-style verb.
card.plain: It marks the spot just before a number like 65 or 36 hours, or before a quoted definition, where a rule word like "shall" would not fit.
